Turn Undead isn't just a spell - it makes undead flee for 2d4 rounds.

GMs: Remind your cleric that Turn Undead isn't a spell; it's a reusable crowd control tool for 2d4 rounds.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Draconic Sorcery's resource allocation surprises many - the real breakpoint is knowing when to conserve.

DMs: Remind them that Draconic Sorcery's limited spell slots demand conservation; don't waste them before page 69's Warlock showdown.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Alignment confuses new players - it's cosmic allegiance, not personal morality.

Judges: Enforce alignment as cosmic allegiance - Law, Neutrality, or Chaos - to guide patron choices and spell access, not personal ethics.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Vision and Light mechanics often surprise players - darkness imposes disadvantage on attack rolls.

DMs: Enforce disadvantage on attack rolls in darkness per Vision and Light rules to remind players of their light source negligence.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Choking Cloud's lethality often surprises - the spell's power scales dramatically with the roll.

Judges: Aim Choking Cloud at foes with Fortitude saves under 12; otherwise, you're just wasting a spell and your breath.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Dungeon brief: Wand Of Unlife.

GMs: Target a challenge where a single animate dead can shift the odds, but don't let them burn more than 2 Constitution.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Give Gray Ooze a real price.

DMs: Place Gray Ooze in areas where players rely on elemental magic, exploiting its resistances to acid, cold, and fire.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Red Robe Hollow One surprises with its spellcasting versatility - a +6 spell check for 1st-level spells.

Judges: Force it into melee to exploit its AC 12, and disrupt its +6 spellcasting before it splits or shifts.

Morale checks catch players off guard - DC 15 WIS when half the monsters fall.

GMs: When half the monsters drop, enforce a DC 15 WIS Morale check to prevent pointless bloodshed.

Giant Slayer (Rapier) can trip up players expecting easy damage - its bonus only triggers against Giants.

DMs: Remind players that the Giant Slayer's 2d6 bonus damage and knockdown only trigger against creatures with the Giant type.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Dinosaurs gain a decisive advantage from lazy positioning - their double near (fly) movement ensures rapid.

GM: Use their double near (fly) to punish players who cluster; force them to respect the 1d8 beak grab.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Dropping to 0 Hit Points doesn't always mean death - instant death occurs only when damage exceeds maximum.

DMs: Apply the same 0 Hit Points rule - instant death if damage exceeds max HP - to both players and monsters.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.
